source_claim: AlphaEvolve uses an evolutionary database inspired by MAP-Elites, where quality-diversity descriptors should be task-meaningful or otherwise stable enough to support archive semantics
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve MAP-Elites snapshots include descriptor policy axes, descriptor-model revision metadata, dynamic diversity reference ids, an explicit no-rebin insertion-time coordinate policy, per-cell finite descriptor-value snapshots, retained elite/Pareto/metric-cell descriptor-value snapshots, diagnostic comparison of retained snapshot descriptor values against history admission descriptors, restore-time axes/model validation, readiness overclaim rejection, and metric/evaluation-metadata/candidate-metadata axis options. It does not claim stable task behavior descriptor contracts, learned descriptor models, evaluator-provided descriptor models, descriptor training inputs, restore-compatible descriptor revisioning, full archive rebin engines, or partial archive rebin engines.
